text.p: Here is a brief profile of International Olympic Committee (IOC) president Juan Antonio Samaranch who announced on Wednesday that he would stand again for re-election to lead the organisation into the 21st century.
Education: Higher Institute of Business Studies, Barcelona. Higher diploma in Business Studies.
Languages: Spanish, French, English, some knowledge of Russian and German.
Career: Economics professor, member of the board of several banks, Municipal Councillor responsible for sport in Barcelona, Spanish Ambassador to the former Soviet Union and Mongolia.
Sports administration: President of Spanish Olympic Committee. Chef de mission at Olympic Games (Cortina d'Ampezzo 1956, Rome 1960, Tokyo 1964)
IOC career: Member since 1966. Member of Executive Board (1970-1978 and 1979-), vice-president of the IOC (1974-1978), President of the IOC (1980-)
